intent: Establish a current, itemised preservation ledger for every local and remote PatterStage branch, registered worktree, sibling validation clone and open pull request before closing or removing any of them. Reconcile the old T-0003 assumptions with the current dev tree and the accepted release order.

reasons.evidence: The audited ledger will be committed and pushed to dev; this batch changes no remote ref or PR state.

programme: The operator prioritised branch and PR consolidation before T-0158. T-0170 carried PR #234's liveness behaviour onto dev; all push and PR jobs for dev@cf43a4f7, including acceptance, completed successfully. This batch establishes the evidence and disposition boundaries. Any external closure or deletion follows as a separate ruled action.
invariants: Every registered worktree, sibling validation clone, local branch, remote branch and open PR at the inspected revision has a ledger row or an explicit grouping with exact identity.
Working-file differences, unreachable commits, stashes and ignored state are not declared safe to delete solely because a branch tip is an ancestor or patch-equivalent to dev.
No ref, checkout, PR, release or repository setting changes in this evidence batch; protected, derived and append-only files are handled by their normal procedures.
rollback: Revert the evidence report and its task closure if a checked identity is wrong; retain every ref and checkout for a fresh audit.
verification: The report contains 16 registered-worktree rows and 14 open-PR rows, matching git worktree list and gh pr list at the inspected cf43a4f7 revision. git ls-remote --heads origin returned 15 exact heads: main, dev and each of the 13 other PR heads. All four hosted workflows for cf43a4f7 completed successfully, with every PR job including acceptance-gate green. git diff --check and node scripts/tooling/check-doc-links.mjs passed. npm run docs:check passed outside the sandbox: 75 pages, 21 routes, every guide accounted for. Derived views are rendered and checked at closure. No code, executable gate, ref, PR or repository setting was changed.
review: Three disjoint read-only agents checked registered worktrees, open remote PRs and PR #234's seven changed paths. A separate sceptic found two sibling validation clones omitted by git worktree list; the report now includes the dirty gate clone's T-0169 stash and checkpoint ref, and the older validation clone's 201 expanded dirty paths. Follow-up blob comparisons named 30 registered-worktree files differing from dev, four differing gate-clone files and 15 differing validation-clone files; .npmrc and hermes.env were deliberately left unverified as potentially sensitive. Ten outside-dev commits were patch-equivalent and the two other changed test blobs matched dev exactly. The clones remain unclassified for deletion and are retained.
mutation: Not applicable to an evidence-only review; no executable gate or application behaviour changes.
deviation: The first sandboxed docs:check failed before project code with Node os.userInfo uv_os_get_passwd ENOMEM. The same Node user lookup succeeded outside the sandbox; the unchanged docs:check then passed. No check was weakened or skipped. This evidence-only review did not use a red-first product oracle or mutation sweep because it changes no executable behaviour; the next implementation batch retains those requirements.
